sources.title: How To Run LFM2.5-2.6B Locally On Windows, Mac And Linux
sources.snippet: Released on 4 August 2026, LFM2.5-2.6B is a 2.6-billion-parameter text model aimed at tool use, data extraction, RAG and long-running agent workflows. Liquid AI lists a 128K context window and native tool calling, but it also gives an unusually useful warning: this is not its recommended model for agentic coding or knowledge-heavy work. That honesty matters.
